# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 93 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 93

**1** Jesus said: "Don't give sacred things to dogs — they'll toss it on the rubbish heap. And don't throw pearls to pigs — they'll trample it into the mud."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Sacred things" — *petouaab* as the set-apart, consecrated
- "Rubbish heap" — contemporary equivalent of the dung heap
- "Trample it into the mud" — the pigs' action as destruction by trampling (combining Matthew's "trample" with Thomas's mud)
